raw.notes: 2-hit OD projectile; LP+MP gives the shorter/slower 236LP version (most useful for approaching from midrange); LP+HP gives the farther/faster 236MP version (more useful as a traditional zoning projectile); hold button 17f for charged version (faster ending projectile speed); 2nd hit puts opponents into a limited juggle state; can only have 1 OD Sun Shot on-screen at a time (but can be used in conjunction with another meterless Sun Shot); projectile disappears 1f after Ingrid is hit; extends a slight projectile invuln hand hitbox on frames 18-44 and a foot hurtbox on frames 18-45; SA2 cancel: KD+61/+10

cargo.notes: 2-hit OD projectile; LP+MP gives the shorter/slower 236LP version (most useful for approaching from midrange); LP+HP gives the farther/faster 236MP version (more useful as a traditional zoning projectile); hold button 17f for charged version (faster ending projectile speed); 2nd hit puts opponents into a limited juggle state; can only have 1 OD Sun Shot on-screen at a time (but can be used in conjunction with another meterless Sun Shot); projectile disappears 1f after Ingrid is hit; extends a slight projectile invuln hand hitbox on frames 18-44 and a foot hurtbox on frames 18-45; SA2 cancel: KD+61/+10

records.name: OD Low Tiger Shot
records.reason: Cargo 236LPMP or 236LPHP の通常hit KD +52からKD後の数値だけがraw 52と本番+52へ保存。公式の対応する基本行もD。CH/PC・空中・派生の注記は通常KDとは別。

raw.name: OD Low Tiger Shot
raw.notes: Fast 2-hit OD projectile; can hit crouching opponents; can be used while a meterless Tiger Shot is still on-screen; the projectile travels low to the ground, preventing many low profile attacks from avoiding it (e.g. Kimberly's slide, A.K.I.'s Sinister Slide); Sagat is in a crouching state for the entire move duration with crouch-sized hurtboxes; puts opponents into a limited juggle state; extends a slight projectile invincible arm hurtbox on frames 16-37 and a leg hurtbox on frames 12-44; topmost hurtboxes are vulnerable only to air attacks on frames 1-44 (more vulnerable to jump-ins despite crouching) and are projectile invincible on frames 1-29 to avoid High Tiger Shot (frames 30-44 are still vulnerable); starter scaling does not apply if only the 2nd hit connects (e.g. clashing with 1-hit OD fireball or breaking Drive Impact armor)

cargo.notes: Fast 2-hit OD projectile; can hit crouching opponents; can be used while a meterless Tiger Shot is still on-screen; the projectile travels low to the ground, preventing many low profile attacks from avoiding it (e.g. Kimberly's slide, A.K.I.'s Sinister Slide); Sagat is in a crouching state for the entire move duration with crouch-sized hurtboxes; puts opponents into a limited juggle state; extends a slight projectile invincible arm hurtbox on frames 16-37 and a leg hurtbox on frames 12-44; topmost hurtboxes are vulnerable only to air attacks on frames 1-44 (more vulnerable to jump-ins despite crouching) and are projectile invincible on frames 1-29 to avoid High Tiger Shot (frames 30-44 are still vulnerable); starter scaling does not apply if only the 2nd hit connects (e.g. clashing with 1-hit OD fireball or breaking Drive Impact armor)

records.name: MP Talim ng Hangin
records.group: ヒット時自動派生と代表ヒット
records.reason: Cargo通常MPは+2を直接記載し、rawも+2。備考は最後2ヒットがヒット時のみ自動継続と説明し、公式も2段目以降はヒット時派生。初段と全段の代表条件が一致するか未確定。
records.missingEvidence: 初段・全段完走のどちらを通常ヒットの代表値とするかと、その明示値。

raw.name: MP Talim ng Hangin
raw.notes: Puts Yasmine into Bayani Mode on hit (this occurs after the hitstop of the 1st hit ends, so it will be granted when Super canceled but not if it trades with opponent's attack); safe on block advancing special; last 2 hits only play out on hit and are not cancelable (listed recovery refers to the blocked version); 3f extra recovery on whiff; 4f extra recovery when absorbed by armor (guaranteed punish when absorbed by Drive Impact unless canceled into SA3); counter-hit/Punish Counter bonus advantage carries through both hits (gives light confirms on CH and medium confirms on PC); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (follow-ups are usually only possible in the corner)

cargo.notes: Puts Yasmine into Bayani Mode on hit (this occurs after the hitstop of the 1st hit ends, so it will be granted when Super canceled but not if it trades with opponent's attack); safe on block advancing special; last 2 hits only play out on hit and are not cancelable (listed recovery refers to the blocked version); 3f extra recovery on whiff; 4f extra recovery when absorbed by armor (guaranteed punish when absorbed by Drive Impact unless canceled into SA3); counter-hit/Punish Counter bonus advantage carries through both hits (gives light confirms on CH and medium confirms on PC); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (follow-ups are usually only possible in the corner)
